definition_en: to make something easier to understand or do
core_image: 一团缠结的线被慢慢理成一条直线
scene: 老师把复杂的规则简化成三条。The teacher simplified the complex rules into three points.
sceneCN: 这里 simplify 是「简化」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老师把复杂的规则简化成三条。

senses.title: To make easier to understand
senses.definition: to make something less difficult to understand
senses.definitionCN: 使某事物不那么难懂
senses.example: The teacher simplified the complex rules into three points.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把复杂的规则简化成三条。
senses.why: This is the everyday sense of making ideas easier.
senses.whyCN: 这是把想法变容易的日常义项。

senses.title: To make less complex

senses.definitionCN: 去掉部分零件，使事物运作更简单
senses.example: The new app simplifies the booking process.

senses.why: The same action applies to objects and systems.
senses.whyCN: 同样的动作也适用于物品和系统。

intro.en: Simplify joins the Latin words for simple and to make.
intro.cn: simplify 由拉丁语中表示「简单」和「做」的词组合而成。

items.en: Simplus meant simple or single.
items.cn: simplus 意为简单的或单一的。

items.en: Facere meant to make or do.
Simplifier meant to make simple.
English borrowed it as simplifien.
The spelling became simplify.

note.en: Simplify is compared with similar-looking verbs and with verbs for making clear.
note.cn: 把 simplify 与形近动词以及表示澄清的动词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To simplify is to give less, but let more be understood.
normalIntro.cn: simplify 就是减少内容，却让人听懂更多。

normal.en: The teacher simplified the complex rules into three points.
normal.cn: 老师把复杂的规则简化成三条。

normal.en: The new app simplifies the booking process.
normal.cn: 新应用简化了预订流程。

normal.en: We need to simplify the form before printing it.
normal.cn: 打印之前我们需要简化这张表格。

normal.en: He simplified his speech for younger listeners.
normal.cn: 他为了让年轻听众听懂而简化了讲稿。

normal.en: Good design simplifies daily life.
normal.cn: 好的设计能简化日常生活。

abstract.en: Simplification is the art of keeping what matters.
abstract.cn: 简化是保留真正重要之物的艺术。

abstract.en: A simple line can hold a whole story.
abstract.cn: 一条简单的线也能承载整个故事。

abstract.en: Taking away can be a form of giving.
abstract.cn: 拿走一些东西，也可以是一种给予。

sensesIntro.en: Simplify means to make something easier to understand or less complex.
sensesIntro.cn: simplify 意为使某事物更容易理解或更不复杂。

core.en: Reduce complication so that the point shows.
core.cn: 减少复杂之处，让要点显露。

branches.en: A complicated rule becomes three clear points.

branches.cn: 应用减少了预订流程的步骤。

branches.en: Ideas and systems can both be made simple.
branches.cn: 想法和系统都能被简化。

branches.en: A teacher speaks so that beginners follow.
branches.cn: 老师讲解得让初学者也能跟上。

branches.cn: 设计只保留用户真正需要的部分。

intro.cn: simplify 展示了 -ify 如何把形容词变成动词。

latinIntro.en: Simplify comes from Latin simplus and facere.
latinIntro.cn: simplify 来自拉丁语 simplus 和 facere。

definition_en: in an easy way, only, or plainly
core_image: 一杯清水放在空桌上，没有任何多余装饰
scene: 他只是想帮忙。He simply wanted to help.
sceneCN: 这里 simply 是「仅仅」（第 2 个义项）；句意：他只是想帮忙。

senses.title: In an easy way
senses.definition: in a way that is easy to understand or do
senses.definitionCN: 以容易理解或做到的方式
senses.example: The machine is simply designed.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器的设计很简单。
senses.why: This is the adverb form of simple.
senses.whyCN: 这是 simple 的副词形式。

senses.title: Only or just
senses.definition: used to stress that something is no more than what is said
senses.definitionCN: 用于强调不过如此
senses.example: He simply wanted to help.
senses.exampleCN: 他只是想帮忙。
senses.why: The idea of no extra part grows into just.
senses.whyCN: 「没有多余部分」的念头引申为「只是」。

senses.title: Plainly
senses.definition: used to stress a plain fact
senses.definitionCN: 用于强调显而易见的事实
senses.example: The view was simply beautiful.
senses.exampleCN: 那景色简直美极了。
senses.why: A plain statement needs no ornament.
senses.whyCN: 平实的陈述不需要装饰。

intro.en: Simply is simple with the adverb suffix -ly.
intro.cn: simply 是 simple 加副词后缀 -ly。

items.en: Simplus meant single or plain.

root: 由拉丁语 simplus（单一的、朴素的）经古法语 simple 进入英语，再加副词后缀 -ly。

sensesIntro.en: Simply means in an easy way, only, or plainly.
sensesIntro.cn: simply 意为简单地、仅仅或简直。

core.en: No extra part, no extra word.

branches.en: A machine works with few parts.

branches.en: A plain view needs no praise.

latinIntro.en: Simply goes back to Latin simplus.

items.example: Her dress has elegance and simplicity.

definition_en: an act that breaks a religious or moral law
core_image: 教堂里低垂的烛火与忏悔的人影
scene: 在许多宗教里，偷窃被视为罪孽。In many religions, stealing is considered a sin.
sceneCN: 这里 sin 是「罪孽」（第 1 个义项）；句意：在许多宗教里，偷窃被视为罪孽。

senses.title: A wrong against religious law
senses.definition: an act that breaks a law of God or a religion
senses.definitionCN: 违反上帝或宗教律法的行为
senses.example: In many religions, stealing is considered a sin.
senses.exampleCN: 在许多宗教里，偷窃被视为罪孽。
senses.why: This is the oldest and strongest sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老也最强烈的义项。

senses.title: A serious moral wrong
senses.definition: a very bad act in moral terms
senses.definitionCN: 道德意义上非常恶劣的行为
senses.example: Cruelty to children is a sin no law can excuse.
senses.exampleCN: 虐待儿童是任何法律都无法开脱的罪恶。
senses.why: The religious word widened into moral judgment.
senses.whyCN: 宗教用语扩展为道德评判。

senses.title: A small fault
senses.definition: a minor fault or mistake
senses.definitionCN: 轻微的过错或失误
senses.example: He treats every mistake as a sin.
senses.exampleCN: 他把每一个错误都当成过失。
senses.why: In casual use the word can sound gentle.
senses.whyCN: 在口语中这个词也可以显得轻微。

intro.en: Sin is one of the oldest moral words in English.
intro.cn: sin 是英语中最古老的道德词汇之一。

branches.en: A believer names stealing a sin.

definition_en: from a past time until now, or because
core_image: 一条从过去延伸到现在的时间线
scene: 自从搬到海边，她的睡眠好多了。Since moving to the coast, she has slept much better.
sceneCN: 这里 since 是「从…以来」（第 1 个义项）；句意：自从搬到海边，她的睡眠好多了。

senses.title: From a past time until now
senses.definition: starting at a past point and continuing to the present
senses.definitionCN: 从过去某点开始并持续到现在
senses.example: Since moving to the coast, she has slept much better.
senses.exampleCN: 自从搬到海边，她的睡眠好多了。
senses.why: This is the time sense that names the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是赋予该词名称的时间义项。

senses.title: Because
senses.definition: used to give a reason
senses.definitionCN: 用于给出原因
senses.example: Since you are here, we can start.
senses.exampleCN: 既然你来了，我们就可以开始。
senses.why: A reason reached from an earlier fact turned into because.
senses.whyCN: 从先前事实推出原因，便有了「因为」。

senses.title: Before now
senses.definition: at a time before the present, in old use
senses.definitionCN: 在现在之前某时，属较旧用法
senses.example: He left long since.
senses.exampleCN: 他很久以前就离开了。
senses.why: The adverb kept a small separate life.
senses.whyCN: 副词用法保留了独立的小义项。

abstract.en: Time does not pass; we stand since it began.

abstract.en: Every number is a step in a long stair.
abstract.cn: 每个数字都是长阶梯上的一级。

examples.en: She will be sixteen next month.
examples.cn: 她下个月就满十六岁了。

examples.en: At sixteen he left for the city.
examples.cn: 他十六岁时去了城里。

examples.en: Sixteen of the seats were empty.
examples.cn: 有十六个座位空着。

dict_mnemonic.text: six（六）+ -teen（十几）= sixteen；注意重音在 -teen 上，和 sixty 的重音位置不同。

root: 源自古英语 siextiene（十六），由 siex（六）加 -tiene 构成。

sensesIntro.en: Sixteen means the number sixteen or a group of sixteen.
sensesIntro.cn: sixteen 意为数字十六或十六个一组。

core.en: Six plus ten.
core.cn: 六加十。

branches.en: A girl turns sixteen next month.
branches.cn: 一个女孩下个月满十六岁。

branches.en: Teams are placed in groups of sixteen.
branches.cn: 队伍被分为十六个一组。

branches.en: The age and the group share one number.
branches.cn: 年龄与分组共用一个数字。

branches.en: Sixteen candles light a birthday cake.
branches.cn: 十六根蜡烛照亮生日蛋糕。

branches.en: Sixteen seats form a full row.
branches.cn: 十六个座位排成完整一行。

intro.en: Sixteen shows -teen making a number above ten.
intro.cn: sixteen 展示了 -teen 构成十几的数词。

latinIntro.en: Sixteen is Germanic, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: sixteen 属日耳曼语，并非拉丁语。

items.exampleCN: 他们庆祝了她的十六岁生日。

items.example: The hall holds sixteen hundred people.
items.exampleCN: 大厅可容纳一千六百人。

definition_zh: 第六个；月的第六日；六分之一
definition_en: coming after the fifth, the sixth day of a month, or one of six equal parts
core_image: 跑道终点旁标着第六名的号码牌
scene: 他跑完了第六场比赛。He finished his sixth race.
sceneCN: 这里 sixth 是「第六个」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他跑完了第六场比赛。

senses.title: The ordinal number
senses.definition: coming after the fifth in order
senses.definitionCN: 在顺序上排在第五之后的
senses.example: He finished his sixth race.
senses.exampleCN: 他跑完了第六场比赛。
senses.why: This is the basic ordinal sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的序数义项。

senses.title: A day of the month
senses.definition: the sixth day of a month
senses.definitionCN: 一个月的第六天
senses.example: The meeting is on the sixth of May.
senses.exampleCN: 会议在五月六日。
senses.why: Ordinals name days in dates.
senses.whyCN: 序数用于日期中的日。

senses.title: One of six parts
senses.definition: one of six equal parts of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物六个等份中的一份
senses.example: A sixth of the class was absent.
senses.exampleCN: 班里六分之一的人缺席。
senses.why: The ordinal doubles as a fraction word.
senses.whyCN: 序数兼作分数词。

intro.en: Sixth is the old ordinal form of six.
intro.cn: sixth 是 six 的古老序数形式。

items.en: Siexta meant sixth.
The form became sixte or sixth.
items.cn: 词形演变为 sixte 或 sixth。

items.en: The spelling settled as sixth.
It names dates and ranks.
It also means one sixth of a whole.
items.cn: 它也指整体的六分之一。

note.en: Sixth is compared with similar-looking words and fraction words.
note.cn: 把 sixth 与形近词以及表示分数的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Sixth puts six in order or cuts a whole into six.
normalIntro.cn: sixth 把六排成顺序，或把整体切成六份。

normal.en: He finished his sixth race.
normal.cn: 他跑完了第六场比赛。

normal.en: The meeting is on the sixth of May.
normal.cn: 会议在五月六日。

normal.en: A sixth of the class was absent.
normal.cn: 班里六分之一的人缺席。

normal.en: She came sixth in the final.
normal.cn: 她在决赛中得了第六名。

normal.en: He has a sixth sense for danger.
normal.cn: 他对危险有第六感。

abstract.en: Order gives every step a name.
abstract.cn: 顺序让每一步都有了名字。

abstract.en: A fraction is a whole learning to share.
abstract.cn: 分数是整体在学习分享。

abstract.en: The sixth place is still a place.
abstract.cn: 第六名也仍然是一个名次。

examples.en: He finished his sixth race.
examples.cn: 他跑完了第六场比赛。

examples.en: She came sixth in the final.
examples.cn: 她在决赛中得了第六名。

examples.en: The meeting is on the sixth of May.
examples.cn: 会议在五月六日。

dict_mnemonic.text: six（六）+ -th（序数后缀）= sixth；类似的还有 fourth（第四）、fifth（第五），注意拼写变化。

root: 源自古英语 siexta（第六），由 siex（六）加序数后缀构成。

sensesIntro.en: Sixth means the ordinal number, a date, or one of six equal parts.
sensesIntro.cn: sixth 意为第六个、某月六日或六分之一。

core.en: Six seen as an order or a share.
core.cn: 把六看作顺序或份额。

branches.en: A runner completes a sixth race.
branches.cn: 跑者完成第六场比赛。

branches.en: A date is fixed on the sixth day.
branches.cn: 日期定在六日。

branches.en: A whole is cut into six equal parts.
branches.cn: 整体被切成六个等份。

branches.en: Rank and date both use an ordinal.
branches.cn: 名次与日期都使用序数。

branches.en: The sixth in line and one sixth of a whole share a form.
branches.cn: 排第六与六分之一共用一种形式。

intro.en: Sixth shows -th turning six into an ordinal.
intro.cn: sixth 展示了 -th 把 six 变成序数。

latinIntro.en: Sixth is Germanic, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: sixth 属日耳曼语，并非拉丁语。

items.exampleCN: 第六，我们需要更多时间。

items.example: Sixteen is ten more than six.
One sixth of the land is forest.
items.exampleCN: 六分之一的土地是森林。
